classification.difficultyReason: Sketch three linear functions using two intercepts, or the origin and a second point when both intercepts coincide.

answer.worked:
When $x=0$,
$$y=-3(0)-6=-6.$$
When $y=0$,
$$\begin{align*}0&=-3x-6\\3x&=-6\\x&=-2.\end{align*}$$
Plot $(-2,0)$ and $(0,-6)$, then draw the straight line through them.

answer.worked:
When $x=0$,
$$y=\frac12(0)-2=-2.$$
When $y=0$,
$$\begin{align*}0&=\frac12x-2\\\frac12x&=2\\x&=4.\end{align*}$$
Plot $(0,-2)$ and $(4,0)$, then draw the straight line through them.

answer.worked:
When $x=0$,
$$y=-\frac12(0)=0.$$
Both intercepts are zero. Choose $x=2$ to obtain another point:
$$y=-\frac12(2)=-1.$$
Plot $(0,0)$ and $(2,-1)$, then draw the straight line through them.
